commit.message: fix(code_mappings): Allow dry run orgs and fix SENTRY-WDH (#41067) This fixes that we were not letting a subset of orgs to run even when calling with dry run set as True and fixes SENTRY-WDH where we were calling `.files` when we should have been calling `["files"]`. This also changes what objects are passed to _generate_code_mapping_from_tree in order to allow the issue details page to show the variable in the stacktrace context and allow for better debuggability. Currently, the stacktrace does not show the contents of `self`. This change will allow the `repo_tree` variable to be printed out.
